title: Topic icons
chooser-help: Users pick from the library only; they cannot upload their own images. Only the topic author or a moderator can change the icon later.
show-in-topic: Show the icon in the topic header
default-icon-help: Shown for topics without an icon, unless their category has its own default.
library-help: Order is the order in the picker. An icon limited to no category is offered everywhere. Switched-off icons are no longer offered, but topics that already use them keep them. Removing an icon takes it off its topics (the category default is shown instead). Images: PNG, WebP or SVG, up to %1 KB; square images of 64×64 px or more look best.
empty-library: The library is empty. Add an icon or restore the built-in ones.
category-defaults-help: Icon shown for topics in a category when the author did not pick one.
confirm-remove: Remove the icon “%1”? Topics that use it will show the category default instead.
confirm-restore: Add the built-in icons that are missing from the library?
restored: Built-in icons added. Save to keep the change.
save-blocked: The settings could not be loaded, so saving is disabled to avoid overwriting them.
uploaded: Image uploaded. Save to keep the change.
upload-type: Only PNG, WebP and SVG images are accepted, and the content must match the file extension.
upload-size: The image is too large (at most %1 KB).
upload-svg-unsafe: This SVG contains scripts, event handlers or external links and was refused.
error.icons-json: The icon library is not valid JSON.
error.row-id: Icon %1: invalid id (lower-case letters, digits and dashes).
error.row-duplicate: Icon %1: the id is used twice.
error.row-url: Icon %1: the image must be a site path (/…) or an https URL ending in .png, .webp or .svg.
error.row-name: Icon %1: the name is longer than %2 characters.
error.chooser: Unknown value of “Who can choose an icon”.
error.chooser-group: Choose the group whose members can pick icons.
error.default-unknown: The forum-wide default icon is not in the library.
error.category-defaults: The category defaults are not valid JSON.
error.category-default-unknown: The default icon of category %1 is not in the library.
